title: A modification that exercises an option
why: The schema's action_type enum separates option_exercise from modification, and the distinction is the one an investor cares about: exercising a priced option is planned continuation, a modification is new scope. The prose calls this action a 'modification' in its first sentence and an option exercise in its second.
verified_against: the announcement prose, by hand. Not verified against any model output -- cache/llm/ is empty.
caveat: action_type here is a convention, not a fact printed in the prose: the text supports both labels and schemas.ACTION_TYPES forces a choice. This case fixes the convention (option_exercise wins when the text says an option is exercised) so that a later skill rule cannot flip it without the change being visible. The dollar figures and the identifiers in this case are plain facts from the text.

checks.quote: KBR Wyle Services LLC, Lexington Park, Maryland, is awarded a $25,162,568 cost-plus-fixed-fee modification (P00003) to a previously awarded contract (N0042125C1001). The modification exercises an option to provide continued program management, engineering, financial, and logistics support for the F/A-18 air vehicle
checks.reason: 'The modification exercises an option' is explicit. modification_number and base_contract_number are still filled -- an option exercise is a modification in form.

checks.quote: FMS customer funds in the amount of $23,213,236 will be obligated at the time of the award
checks.reason: $23,213,236 is the obligation; the action is $25,162,568.

checks.quote: General Dynamics Information Technology Inc., Falls Church, Virginia, was awarded a $43,874,231 cost-only modification to previously awarded contract (N6339423C0009) for in-service engineering support of the MK 41 Vertical Launching System
checks.reason: The control for the case above: a modification with no option language and no modification number printed. action_type modification, modification_number null -- not an invented P-number.
